# Center for Blockchain & Smart Contract Security

> A European resource hub for learning blockchain and smart contract security. Curated by Rey Olson, an information security specialist based in Belgium. Covers Ethereum, Solana, DeFi, bridge security, CBDCs, regulation, CTF challenges, and the Secureum bootcamp series. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

## About the Site

The Center for Blockchain & Smart Contract Security (smartcontractsecurity.eu) was created in August 2021 by Rey Olson as a way to share curated resources about blockchain and smart contract security. Rey is an information security specialist based in Belgium, with a background in IT at a large bank and consulting at a Big Four firm. During the 2020 pandemic, he rediscovered cryptocurrencies and Ethereum, which led to this site. The site is built with Publii CMS, hosted on GitHub, and served via Cloudflare. All content is licensed under CC BY 4.0.

Contact: https://twitter.com/ReyOlson4 | https://www.linkedin.com/in/rey-olson

---

## Main Pages

### Home
URL: https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/
The homepage lists all articles in reverse chronological order. The site's mission is to help people learn how to keep digital assets safe and secure on blockchain technology and distributed ledger technology (DLT).

### About
URL: https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/about-2/
Rey lives in Belgium with his wife and three children. He began his career in IT at a large bank, worked as a consultant at a Big Four company, and is currently an information security specialist in the financial sector. He created this website in August 2021 to share his love of blockchain and smart contract security.

### Services
URL: https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/security-audit-services/
Rey does not offer professional security or audit services himself. For Web3 or Web2 security expertise, he refers visitors to Spearbit (world-class independent security researchers) and Cantina (the first marketplace for web3 security, incubated by Spearbit). For the traditional approach, he points to his curated list of audit firms.

### Contact
URL: https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/contact/

## Resource Categories

### Secureum
URL: https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/secureum/
The Secureum bootcamp is a series on smart contract security auditing. The site covers all parts of the Secureum curriculum: Ethereum 101, Solidity 101, Solidity 201, Security Pitfalls & Best Practices 101 & 201, Audit Techniques & Tools 101, Audit Findings 101 & 201.

### Capture The Flag
URL: https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/capture-the-flag-challenges/
